ping_compensation_system.gloo_wall_fix: Damage dealt by ammo fired before a Gloo Wall placement command is registered will now take effect.
ping_compensation_system.movement_smoothing: Reduced abnormal teleportation/clipping seen by opponents during high lag spikes.

contextual_hud_pins.gloo_wall: Requests or reports Gloo Wall count
contextual_hud_pins.weapon_bar: Requests ammo for equipped gun or requests a gun if unarmed

quick_chat_tool_revamp.alert_mode: Auto-switches to Alert status when player takes damage.
quick_chat_tool_revamp.combat_auto_disable: Non-essential tactical chat popups auto-disable during combat.

teammate_recognition.overhead_markers: Displays colored numbers above teammates' characters.
teammate_recognition.offscreen_indicators: Edge-of-screen color-coded indicators for out-of-sight teammates.

movement_animation.multi_directional_jumps: Players can turn jump direction while camera position remains locked.

battle_prep_system.unified_strategy_page: Combines character skills, pet skills, and loadouts into 2 toggleable preset pages.

regional_weapon_glory_leaderboard.score_model: Base Score + Ranked Performance Points * Coefficient (decay applies if weapon unused)

social_and_duo.character_skill_share: Dynamic Duo partners share access to all owned character skills.
